site.name: Web App
site.description: A multilingual starter for new web apps.

cookies.intro: We use cookies and similar technologies to operate the website, keep your account secure, remember your language preference, measure usage, and improve our service.
cookies.necessaryBlurb: Necessary cookies are always active because they are required for login, security, and core website functionality. With your consent, we also use analytics and marketing or attribution technologies such as Google Analytics and Google-related storage.
cookies.choiceBlurb: You can accept all cookies, reject non-essential cookies, or customize your choices.

necessary.title: Necessary cookies
necessary.description: Required for login, account security, CSRF protection, session management, and core website functionality. These cookies cannot be disabled through this panel.

preferences.title: Preferences cookies
preferences.description: Used to remember your selected language and interface preferences.

analytics.title: Analytics cookies
analytics.description: Used to understand how visitors use the website, measure traffic, detect usage patterns, and improve the service.

marketing.title: Marketing and attribution
marketing.description: Used to measure campaign performance, conversion events, and attribution through Google-related technologies.
